findings.summary: Criterion 3's liveness signal proves the 1,600 consumers were alive, not that they polled 3,000 times; a consumer that silently stopped polling but still answers the liveness probe would satisfy the assertion. Line reference shifted 158->159 by the one-line Design edit; finding text unchanged from the 5a190e02 pass.
findings.failure_scenario: Mutate the consumer loop to poll once and then park forever while keeping the liveness/heartbeat path intact: store-request count stays at zero, the liveness assertion still passes, and T8/T8b report zero idle cost for a consumer that is not actually consuming. Record the poll-attempt counter, not just liveness.
